verdict.rationale: The evidence offers no explicit statement about whether customer data is used for AI training, and no opt-out setting. It does show self-managed and on-prem deployment, in-cluster model deployment, and bring-your-own vectors. These let a user keep data and inference inside their own infrastructure, which indirectly prevents vendor-side training use. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party no-training data-use policy, a training opt-out control for Elastic Cloud/Serverless, documentation of how hosted inference endpoints handle data, and independent corroboration.
